item.title: Weekly SME IT Update — 2 June 2026
item.description: The SME tech landscape is shifting again, and a few trends are worth keeping an eye on if you run or manage a business relying on cloud services, Microsoft 365, or hybrid infrastructure. Ransomware tactics are changing, cloud costs are rising quietly, Microsoft is pushing secure-by-default, and legacy VPN appliances are becoming a liability.
